note: People born in American Samoa (with Swains Island, the United States' outlying possessions) are United States nationals, not citizens, and owe it allegiance, so they hold its passport, at its fees.

sources.title: United States Code, 2023 edition (govinfo.gov), 8 U.S.C. § 1408, Nationals but not citizens of the United States at birth
sources.said: Unless otherwise provided in section 1401 of this title, the following shall be nationals, but not citizens, of the United States at birth: (1) A person born in an outlying possession of the United States on or after the date of formal acquisition of such possession;

sources.title: United States Code, 2023 edition (govinfo.gov), 8 U.S.C. § 1101(a)(29)
sources.said: (29) The term "outlying possessions of the United States" means American Samoa and Swains Island.

sources.title: United States Code, 2023 edition (govinfo.gov), 22 U.S.C. § 212, Persons entitled to passport
sources.said: No passport shall be granted or issued to or verified for any other persons than those owing allegiance, whether citizens or not, to the United States.
